messages:
Lina: quick FYI — flagged a 404 from the onboarding "Getting Started" checklist: shortlink `kb://deploy-check` resolves to nothing. Noticed during a customer onboarding call. anyone own that doc? :grimacing:
Owen: ugh thanks for the catch. I think that shortlink was meant to map to /kb/playbooks/deploys/deploy-checklist-2025 after the restructure. Might have missed adding the mapping.
Maya (Docs): thanks for reporting. If it's a migrated id then the best path is a tiny redirect + update the top 3 callers. I can help with review.
Lina: callers I saw: onboarding checklist, runtime quickstart, and the engineering handbook TOC.
shortlink-bot: nightly shortlink-scan detected unresolved id 'kb://deploy-check' on 3 pages. Created issue KB-5124 (priority: medium).
Owen: I'll open a small PR that adds a shortlink mapping in data/shortlinks.yml and updates the handbook TOC reference to the canonical path. Will also add a one-line note in the target doc header "migrated in 2025 reorg".
Priyank: quick ask — can we avoid updating the onboarding email template until the redirect is live? That template is cached in the marketing system and hard to roll back. If we do redirect first we avoid a support spike.
Maya (Docs): agreed. Plan: 1) add redirect mapping in one PR, canary deploy to staging docs, confirm template resolves; 2) sweep and update the handbook & quickstart callers in a follow-up PR. That keeps changes isolated.
Owen: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8342 - adds shortlink mapping and tiny header note in the destination doc. Tagging @Maya for review. CI passing.
shortlink-bot: staging deploy queued for branch fix/shortlink-6149876543. Linkcheck pending.
Lina: will test staging after deploy and report back here. I'll check the onboarding flow and the marketing email preview.
Maya (Docs): LGTM on the redirect mapping. Once staging canary looks good, please merge. For the sweep PR please include a short changelog line so I can add it to the docs digest.
Lina: staging canary ✅ — onboarding preview shows the checklist link resolving to /kb/playbooks/deploys/deploy-checklist-2025 and returns 200. No auth issues observed.
Priyank: confirmed from marketing preview as well. No cache issues. :tada:
Owen: merging to prod now. I'll open the follow-up PR to update the three callers and add an owners check for the handbook TOC. ETA ~2h for sweep PR.
Maya (Docs): nice work. Filing follow-up ticket KB-5125 to run a weekly scan for migrated shortlinks and add an "owner ping" to pages that lost mappings during the reorg. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. :rocket:
